 Updated U.S. PCB tariff rates took effect. China (2 & 4-layer FR-4), Thailand, and Vietnam are now subject to a 12.5% tariff, China-origin PCBs other than 2 & 4-layer FR-4 are now 37.5%, and Taiwan remains at 10%.

February 24, 2026

 A 10% global tariff takes effect on PCB imports, while the existing 25% tariff on non-2/4 layer rigid boards from China remains in place (35% total).
